_about: DRAFT Places to Smell register for review. Not read by the app or the build, not published. Wording is our own; every record carries its sources, strength (A official/academic, B trusted press, C brand/listing, D creator/unsourced) and a verification status.

status_values.verified: Operating and visitable, confirmed by an official or two independent recent sources
status_values.partly verified: Exists and likely visitable; some details unconfirmed
status_values.not visitable: Real place but no confirmed or safe visitor access
